description: Browse rentable bare-metal servers for Celestia nodes (validator, bridge or Fibre) from the Unity Nodes Pulse datacenter catalog: 23 hosting providers, price and stock, location, CPU, RAM, NVMe, uplink and traffic terms, and Pulse's own compatibility verdict per node role (Compatible, Needs benchmark, Check caveats, Not compatible) with the reason. Filter by role, verdict, region, country, provider, price and hardware; cheapest first. Celestia node hosting only, not a general server search and not a quote: prices, stock and verdicts are a snapshot refreshed every 15 minutes. Servers that miss a role hardware or price floor are not listed for it, as on the Pulse page. mode real = what Unity Nodes recommends from its own measurements, docs = the larger official Celestia envelope. Fibre verdicts assume the launch-minimum stake: use size_fibre_node for yours. FDP = Celestia Foundation Delegation Program hosting rules. Use get_datacenter_offer for one server and list_datacenter_providers for the provider overview.

hide_fdp_excluded.description: Hide servers the FDP rules exclude for the role (validator unless role is fibre)

include_out_of_stock.description: Also list servers that are currently out of stock

max_price_usd.description: Monthly price ceiling in approximate USD (euro prices at Pulse's fixed 1.12)

min_nvme_gb.description: NVMe capacity in GB the server can reach, counting the provider's storage upgrade options

mode.description: real = Unity Nodes measured minimum, docs = official Celestia docs envelope

provider.description: Provider name or key, e.g. "OVHcloud", "hetzner", "cherry"; see list_datacenter_providers

region.description: eu, na, latam, apac, africa or me (Middle East)

role.description: Only servers Pulse lists for this node role, and show that role verdict. Omit to list servers listed for any role

sort.description: price = cheapest first; ram, nvme, cores = largest first

traffic.description: How the provider bills bandwidth: unmetered, egress (only outbound counted), both (inbound counted too, risky for Fibre) or unknown

verdict.description: Only servers with this verdict for the role (any role when role is omitted)

name: list_datacenter_offers
